messages.author: 374def6c029c6b6b
messages.subject: -f and --args not handled properly
parts:
Using the command line executable, it seems there ared some bugs in argument processing.

1. calling commandArgs() in, say, "renjin -f test.r --args a b c" does not include the "-f test.r" as per GnuR.

2. Multiple arguments that begin with -- after a --args cause an error,e.g.:

renjin -f test1.r --args  --a --b
/Users/mjj/ews/renjin_home/renjin/renjin/renjin-0.8.2050
'b' is not a recognized option
Option              Description                  
------              -----------                  
--args <ARGUMENTS>  Arguments to be passed on to R
-e <EXPR>           Evaluate 'EXPR' and exit     
-f <FILE>           Take input from 'FILE'
